title: 第153章 天剑宗，天裂之变
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【扫描结果如下——】

【封印对象确认：棺椁内封存的是一位修仙者，非妖魔异类。性别：女性。修为：生前为化神后期。】

【当前状态：深度沉睡中，生命体征微弱但稳定。封印灵力持续衰减的原因并非她在主动消磨封印，而是封印本身因时间过于久远自然老化。】

【身份初步推断：根据棺椁外刻录的铭文残片和石室壁画内容，此人极可能是四千年前苍玄界第一剑修宗门“天剑宗”的末代宗主——陆清寒。】

【陆清寒档案：据古籍记载，陆清寒是苍玄界数千年来最年轻的化神期修士，一手“碎星剑诀”独步天下，为人清冷孤傲，但行事光明磊落，斩妖除魔无数。】

【四千年前，一场席卷整个苍玄界的大劫降临，史称“天裂之变”。天剑宗为了守住一座上古封印，全宗上下血战三月，最终以全宗覆灭为代价封住了裂隙。】

【陆清寒本人在那一战中重伤不治，于临终前自封于万年阴沉木棺中，以残存灵力维持封印运转数千年。】

【当前风险等级：低。陆清寒并非邪恶存在，苏醒后不会主动攻击生灵。但由于沉睡时间过久，她的修为已经衰退到了元婴巅峰，苏醒后会有一段短暂的意识模糊期，届时可能会本能地释放剑气护体，若靠得太近，有被误伤的风险。】

【建议处理方案：无需封印或镇压。】

【可在棺材然后以温和的方式唤醒她，告知她四千年的时间已过，天裂之劫已了，让她自行决定去向。】

张瑀愣住了。

天剑宗末代宗主。

四千年。

全宗战死，她重伤不治，自封于棺中，以残存灵力维持封印四千多年。

张瑀看着系统面板上那些文字，又抬起头看了看那具乌黑的棺材。

棺材表面那些暗金色的符文锁链已经断裂了大半，残余的灵力极其微弱——那不是被消磨的，是她在棺材里，用自己最后的生机，撑了整整四千年。

他的拳头不自觉地攥紧了一下。

“张先生？”掌刑天官微微侧过头，察觉到了他情绪的变化。

张瑀摇了摇头，没有解释。

他关掉系统面板，转过身，沿着通道往外走去。

掌刑天官跟在他身后，也没有多问。

通道入口外面，季伯渊正焦急地来回踱着步，看到张瑀出来，连忙迎上去：“张小友，里面到底是什么情况？”

二长老、三长老、女长老和其余几位长老也都围了上来，所有人脸上的表情都紧绷着。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

[Scan results are as follows——]

[Confirmation of the sealed object: The person sealed in the coffin is an immortal cultivator, not a demon or alien.Gender: Female.Cultivation: During his lifetime, he was in the late stage of becoming a god.】

[Current status: In deep sleep, vital signs are weak but stable.The reason why the seal's spiritual power continues to decline is not because she is actively wearing down the seal, but because the seal itself ages naturally over time.】

[Preliminary Identity Inference: Based on the inscription fragments carved outside the coffin and the contents of the stone chamber murals, this person is most likely the last sect leader of the "Tianjian Sect", the first swordsmanship sect in the Cangxuan Realm four thousand years ago - Lu Qinghan.】

[Lu Qinghan Files: According to ancient records, Lu Qinghan is the youngest monk in the god-transformation stage in the Cangxuan Realm for thousands of years. He is unique in the world with his "Star-Breaking Sword Art". He is cold and aloof, but he acts aboveboard and has killed countless demons.】

[Four thousand years ago, a catastrophe swept through the entire Cangxuan Realm, known in history as the "Sky-Splitting Change".In order to keep an ancient seal, the Tianjian Sect fought bloody battles for three months, and finally sealed the rift at the cost of the entire sect's destruction.】

[Lu Qinghan himself was seriously injured and died in that battle. Before his death, he sealed himself in a wooden coffin that had been darkened for thousands of years, and used his remaining spiritual power to keep the seal operating for thousands of years.】

[Current risk level: low.Lu Qinghan is not an evil being and will not actively attack living beings after waking up.However, due to sleeping for too long, her cultivation has declined to the peak of Nascent Soul. After waking up, there will be a brief period of confusion. At that time, she may instinctively release the sword energy to protect her body. If she gets too close, there is a risk of being accidentally injured.】

[Recommended treatment plan: No need to seal or suppress.】

[But he woke her up in a gentle way in the coffin, telling her that four thousand years had passed and the catastrophe was over, and allowed her to decide where to go.】

Zhang Yu was stunned.

The last sect leader of Tianjian Sect.

Four thousand years.

The whole clan died in battle, and she died of serious injuries. She sealed herself in a coffin and used her remaining spiritual power to maintain the seal for more than four thousand years.

Zhang Yu looked at the words on the system panel, then raised his head and looked at the black coffin.

Most of the dark golden rune chains on the surface of the coffin have been broken, and the remaining spiritual power is extremely weak - it was not wasted, but she used her last life in the coffin to hold on for four thousand years.

His fists clenched unconsciously.

"Mr. Zhang?" Zhang Xingtianguan turned his head slightly and noticed the change in his mood.

Zhang Yu shook his head without explaining.

He turned off the system panel, turned around, and walked out along the passage.

The official in charge of punishment followed behind him and didn't ask any questions.

Outside the entrance to the passage, Ji Boyuan was pacing back and forth anxiously. When he saw Zhang Yu coming out, he quickly went to greet him: "Zhang Xiaoyou, what's going on inside?"

The second elder, third elder, female elder and several other elders also gathered around, and the expressions on everyone's faces were tense.
